properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: certifi 2018.11.29 (Nov 2018) pinned in Pipfile.lock is the CA trust bundle for the Python tooling environment (requests-based HTTPS fetches, e.g. tools/codegen/gen_cert_bundle.py). A 2018 bundle predates six-plus years of root rotations — TLS verification in the toolchain leans on a stale trust store. Dev-environment asset, changeable by bumping the pin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: certifi@2018.11.29 in Pipfile.lock — the dependency entry for the same logical asset as the CA trust bundle object: certifi *is* the bundle. Linked so a reader can reference one entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: urllib3 1.24.1 (Dec 2018) pinned in Pipfile.lock — the TLS transport for the Python tooling (used via requests). 1.24.1 predates the 1.24.2 fix for CVE-2019-11324 (certificate verification edge case) and offers no post-quantum capability; dev-environment dependency, changeable by bumping the pin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: requests >=2.19 declared in Pipfile dev-packages — the HTTP client opening TLS sessions for the tooling (with urllib3 1.24.1 as transport and certifi 2018.11.29 as trust store, per the sibling objects). The requests stack is the TLS posture of the dev toolchain, not of the firmware.
